what: Removing lint-bash32 from make lint drops existing untracked shell-file coverage
scenario_or_breakage: The existing whole-repo mode scans git --cached --others, but the new pre-commit run --all-files path only supplies tracked files, so local make lint stops catching Bash 4 constructs in newly created untracked scripts before staging
suggested_fix: Keep lint-bash32 in the lint target and accept the small duplicate local run, or add an equivalent untracked-file scan before removing it

what: Plan adds outside-root absolute-path support while preserving scan_file's ROOT-relative contract
scenario_or_breakage: The proposed positional tests call absolute TMPROOT paths without --root; a literal implementation builds ROOT//tmp/... and skips the file, while fixing it adds complexity for a path pre-commit does not use
suggested_fix: Drop outside-root support from the plan/tests; exercise positional mode with --root TMPROOT and relative paths so scan_file keeps its existing relative contract
